P112.label: founder

P136.description: creative work's genre or an artist's field of work (P101). Use main subject (P921) to relate creative works to their topic

P137.label: operator
P137.description: person, profession, organization or entity that operates the equipment, facility, or service

P1050.label: medical condition

P1035.label: honorific suffix

P1037.label: director / manager

P1064.label: track gauge

P1066.label: student of
P1066.description: person who has taught this person

P1071.label: location of creation
P1071.description: place where the item was conceived or made; where applicable, location of final assembly

P1074.label: fictional or mythical analog of
P1074.description: used to link an entity or class of entities appearing in a creative work with the analogous entity or class of entities in the real world

P1075.label: rector

P1151.label: topic's main Wikimedia portal
P1151.description: Wikimedia portal associated with this topic

P1196.label: manner of death

P1026.label: academic thesis
P1026.description: thesis or dissertation written for a degree

P1027.label: conferred by
P1027.description: person or organization who grants an award, certification, grant, or role

P1211.description: fuel system that an engine uses

P13773.label: LSF rating

P10741.label: dance style
P10741.description: dance style that the subject participates or participated in or is associated with

P12693.label: source of transfer

P12913.description: class that includes the object(s) to which this occurrence (or class of occurrence) occurs or occurred

P12995.label: agent of action

P1344.description: event in which a person, organization or creative work was/is a participant; inverse of P710 or P1923

P11146.label: collection items at

P11849.label: first performance by

P12095.label: fonds
P12095.description: part of an archival collection which an item belongs to

P12328.label: simulates
P12328.description: item simulated, imitated, or made to appear real by this item

P12439.label: civil rank
P12439.description: non-military rank of a civil office holder in Russian Empire

P17.label: country
P17.description: sovereign state that this subject item is in (not to be used for human beings)

P140.label: religion or worldview
P140.description: religion of a person, organization or religious building, or associated with this subject

P144.label: based on
P144.description: the work(s) or inputs used as the basis for subject item; for fictional analog use P1074

P16.label: transport network

P155.description: immediately prior item in a series of which the subject is a part, preferably use as qualifier of P179 [if the subject has replaced the preceding item, e.g. political offices, use "replaces" (P1365)]

P157.label: killed by

P176.label: manufacturer
P176.description: (main or final) manufacturer or producer of this product

P150.label: contains the administrative territorial entity

P167.label: structure replaced by
P167.description: the item which replaced this building or structure, at the same geographic location

P166.label: award received
P166.description: award or recognition received by a person, organization or creative work

P170.label: creator
P170.description: maker of this creative work or other object (where no more specific property exists)

P171.label: parent taxon
P171.description: closest parent taxon of the taxon in question

P175.label: performer

P184.description: person who supervised the doctorate or PhD thesis of the subject

P186.label: made from material
P186.description: material the subject or the object is made of or derived from (do not confuse with P10672 which is used for processes)

P1383.label: contains settlement
P1383.description: settlement which an administrative division contains

P1387.label: political alignment

P1444.description: destination for this route (journey, flight, sailing, exploration, migration, etc.)

P1465.label: category for people who died here

P1640.description: content specialist responsible for this collection or exhibition
